title: Sloth reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='8' y='73' width='84' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A0703A'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#9B7B52'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='16' ry='10' fill='#BFA07A'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='56' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8A6B44' transform='rotate(-20 31 56)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='56' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8A6B44' transform='rotate(20 69 56)'/>
  <!-- claws on right arm -->
  <path d='M67 48 Q69 44 71 47' stroke='#D9C4A0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 49 Q72 45 74 48' stroke='#D9C4A0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws on left arm -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q28 44 26 47' stroke='#D9C4A0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M27 49 Q25 45 23 48' stroke='#D9C4A0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#BFA07A'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#E8D8BC'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='37' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6B4F2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='37' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6B4F2E'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='2.2' fill='#1A1A1A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='2.2' fill='#1A1A1A'/>
  <circle cx='43.7' cy='36.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57.7' cy='36.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#6B4F2E'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 51 56 47' stroke='#8A6B44' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='34' r='4' fill='#BFA07A'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='34' r='4' fill='#BFA07A'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <!-- left page -->
  <path d='M50 50 L30 55 L30 70 L50 66 Z' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- right page -->
  <path d='M50 50 L70 55 L70 70 L50 66 Z' fill='#FFF2D6'/>
  <!-- page lines left -->
  <line x1='33' y1='57' x2='47' y2='54' stroke='#C8B99A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='61' x2='47' y2='58' stroke='#C8B99A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='65' x2='47' y2='62' stroke='#C8B99A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- page lines right -->
  <line x1='53' y1='54' x2='67' y2='57' stroke='#D4C5A5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='58' x2='67' y2='61' stroke='#D4C5A5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='62' x2='67' y2='65' stroke='#D4C5A5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='66' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- book cover edges -->
  <path d='M28 55 L30 56 L30 71 L28 70 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <path d='M72 55 L70 56 L70 71 L72 70 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- book bottom cover -->
  <path d='M28 70 L30 71 L70 71 L72 70 L50 68 Z' fill='#A93226'/>
  <!-- book top cover -->
  <path d='M28 55 L30 56 L50 50 L70 56 L72 55 L50 49 Z' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <!-- paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='58' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#8A6B44'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='58' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#8A6B44'/>
  <!-- claws on paws -->
  <path d='M29 55 Q28 52 30 53' stroke='#D9C4A0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 55 Q72 52 70 53' stroke='#D9C4A0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='68' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#2E7D32' transform='rotate(-30 14 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='68' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#388E3C' transform='rotate(30 86 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='62' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#43A047' transform='rotate(-40 20 62)'/>
</svg>
